description: The chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large for two models, NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model, across various optimizations applied. The vertical axis lists the categories of optimizations applied, namely Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates, in a fixed order. The horizontal axis represents the difference in average WER, labeled as "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large", with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, marked at intervals of 0.001. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with the NESAC ft model depicted in brown and the SESHA ft model in green. The NESAC ft model bars have values of approximately 0.00334 for Normalised, 0.00319 for Add Spacing, 0.00311 for Remove Spacing, 0.00299 for Americanisms, and 0.00257 for Dates. The SESHA ft model bars have values of approximately 0.00323 for Normalised, 0.00344 for Add Spacing, 0.00306 for Remove Spacing, 0.00302 for Americanisms, and 0.00228 for Dates. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order within the groups. No bars are visually emphasized.
